originalManifest.method: Recovered the exact pretty-printed original by restoring the old UI app digest and prior UI label arrays, then applying the fully read canonicalBundleArtifactPayload and parseBundleManifest seal. Whole byte SHA exactly equals the immutable host-run manifest SHA; accepted only after this equality.

interpretation: The eight actual host preparation reports remain evidence for the same 71 business/runtime/SOP/context/transport source bytes. The final UI and projected labels have separate current browser/asset evidence. The original whole manifest differs; this binding does not rewrite history or claim the host used the final UI manifest.
limitations: This is byte/manifest compatibility evidence, not a second host replay.
New PostgreSQL seeding, UI rendering and legacy platform changes require their own current tests.
No claim of real customer, bank, device, partner outreach or production outcomes.
